vitiō

vitiō, vitiāre, vitiāvī, vitiātum

verb, first conjugation

violate, deflower (a girl); in general spoil, corrupt

    the recommended word · classical · Ter. Ad. 466–467: Fīliam ejus virginem vitiāvit.; Ter. Eun. 4.4.37: virginem (Lewis & Short)
